title: Danger in The Dark
description: This data pack makes mobs invisible in the dark, it also makes enemies a lot stronger when invisible in the dark, making dark places and the night absolutely deadly.
body:
This data pack makes mobs invisible in the dark, it also makes enemies a lot stronger when invisible in the dark, making dark places and the night absolutely deadly.

- You can use night vision potion to reveal nearby enemies
- Eating golden food (eg. golden apple, golden carrot) will reveal nearby enemies for a short time
